paragraphs.text: The swimming pool is open from 6.30 am on weekdays and from 8 am at weekends. Lane swimming finishes at 9 pm daily. The sauna is closed on Tuesdays for cleaning.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Badminton courts cost £8 an hour before 5 pm and £12 after that. Members receive a 25 per cent discount. Equipment can be hired at reception for £2 and must be returned within ten minutes of the end of the booking.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: At what time does the pool open on Saturday?

explanation.en: Saturday is a weekend: “from 8 am at weekends” → 8 am.
explanation.kk: Сенбі — демалыс күні: «from 8 am at weekends» → 8 am.
explanation.ru: Суббота — выходной день: «from 8 am at weekends» → 8 am.

items.quote: The sauna is closed on Tuesdays for cleaning
items.prompt: On which day is the sauna closed?

explanation.kk: «closed on Tuesdays for cleaning» → Tuesdays. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.
